pages.text: $(bold)Deuterium$(): one canister lasts 10 minutes at full output. The $(bold)Isotope Column$() makes it from ice or snow, drawing 10 kW. Canisters go in the Fuel Port; hoppers work.

pages.title: Tritium
pages.text: The tank holds 8 units. Ignition uses one. The Lithium Blankets breed a little more than the burn uses.$(br2)For the first tritium, load a $(bold)Lithium Target Rod$() into a CFU-7 rod slot: it breeds 4 canisters.

pages.title: Lithium
pages.text: Mined from Spodumene inside deep Pegmatite. Smelt it to Lithium Carbonate, then refine it in the Isotope Column.

pages.title: Helium
pages.text: Each Deuterium Canister burned leaves a Helium Canister in the Controller's helium slot while the Vacuum Port pumps. One used from there halves the next cooldown.
